name: Asterism
author: E. T. Carter
description: A still star chart over true black: faint hash stars shimmer slowly while constellations materialise one glowing line-segment at a time, hold for a beat, then dissolve as the next is already being traced elsewhere — a perpetual relay of overlapping pen-drawn figures.

params.label: Figure period
params.effect: Seconds each figure takes for its draw-hold-fade life; short values sketch figures briskly, long values make each constellation linger.

params.label: Figure size
params.effect: Radius of the constellation figure in CSS pixels, from a small corner asterism to a frame-dominating chart figure.

params.label: Line width
params.effect: Thickness of the glowing connector lines in CSS pixels, from hairline etching to soft bright strokes.
